dress_and_conduct: Cover thighs to the knee in town or a village; beachwear is fine at hotels and resorts.
Ask permission before photographing people and places; kastoms vary between provinces.
sacred_or_restricted_places: Before going ashore, try to get permission from the relevant chief first.
culture-and-protocol.cultural_authority: Local chiefs; the province (yachts must notify each province they wish to visit).
culture-and-protocol.note: National guidance from Tourism Solomons applied to this province; no province-specific page found.

layers.process: Tetepare Island: the TDA yacht policy hosted in 2019 asks yacht visitors to notify the association before visiting, pay a conservation levy, and have a guide or ranger accompany excursions. Ask TDA to confirm current arrangements and charges.

Tetepare: the TDA yacht policy hosted in 2019 prohibits taking marine resources within the 13 km marine protected area and asks visitors to check its boundary with rangers. It also says non-members may not harvest land crabs on the island. Confirm current rules with TDA.

Tetepare: the TDA yacht policy hosted in 2019 says no anchoring in the marine protected area, directs vessels to Waugh Bay and asks them not to damage reefs. Confirm current anchoring guidance and boundaries with TDA.
